zh-CN.title: 消息删除在所有设备保持同步
items: 可以从自己这里删除任意消息，己方消息还可为所有人撤回
删除会同步清理其他设备的聊天记录与媒体缓存

en.title: Message deletion now syncs across devices
items: Any message can be deleted locally, while your own messages can also be recalled for everyone
Deletions now clear chat history and cached media across devices
